description: This PHP class defines deprecated static methods for performing database-related calculations, such as averaging, counting, summing, and calculating variance and standard deviation on specified data ranges, often used in spreadsheet calculations. The class is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library and serves as a wrapper for specific database functions, currently marked as deprecated in favor of more specific evaluation methods.

classes.name: Database
classes.description: A deprecated class providing static methods for various spreadsheet database functions, acting as a wrapper around specialized evaluation classes.

methods.name: DAVERAGE
methods.description: Calculates the average of selected database entries matching specified criteria, but is deprecated. It delegates to Database\DAverage::evaluate.

methods.name: DCOUNT
methods.description: Counts numeric entries matching criteria in a database, deprecated, delegates to Database\DCount::evaluate.

methods.name: DCOUNTA
methods.description: Counts non-blank entries matching criteria in a database, deprecated, delegates to Database\DCountA::evaluate.

methods.name: DGET
methods.description: Extracts a single value matching criteria, deprecated, delegates to Database\DGet::evaluate.

methods.name: DMAX
methods.description: Finds the maximum value matching criteria, deprecated, delegates to Database\DMax::evaluate.

methods.name: DMIN
methods.description: Finds the minimum value matching criteria, deprecated, delegates to Database\DMin::evaluate.

methods.name: DPRODUCT
methods.description: Calculates the product of entries matching criteria, deprecated, delegates to Database\DProduct::evaluate.

methods.name: DSTDEV
methods.description: Estimates population standard deviation from sample data matching criteria, deprecated, delegates to Database\DStDev::evaluate.

methods.name: DSTDEVP
methods.description: Calculates population standard deviation for entire population, deprecated, delegates to Database\DStDevP::evaluate.

methods.name: DSUM
methods.description: Sums entries matching criteria, deprecated, delegates to Database\DSum::evaluate.

methods.name: DVAR
methods.description: Estimates variance from sample data matching criteria, deprecated, delegates to Database\DVar::evaluate.

methods.name: DVARP
methods.description: Calculates variance for entire population matching criteria, deprecated, delegates to Database\DVarP::evaluate.
